description: Search for Salesforce campaigns using multiple criteria like name, type, status, date range, or active status. Requires access to the Campaign object (Marketing User feature must be enabled in the org). For complex sorting (multi-field ORDER BY), use salesforce.run_soql_query instead.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Campaign fields to retrieve.
fields.human_parameter_description: List the campaign details you want returned, separated by commas (for example: Id,Name,Status).
fields.title: Fields

is_active.description: Filter by active status. True for active campaigns, False for inactive.
is_active.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to include only active campaigns, only inactive ones, or leave blank to include both.
is_active.title: Is Active

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return. Check totalSize in the response to determine if results are truncated; issue additional queries if needed.
limit.human_parameter_description: Set the maximum number of campaigns to return. Higher values show more results but may take longer.
limit.title: Limit

name.description: Search by campaign name. Supports partial matches. Combine with type, status, or date range filters to narrow results when names are non-unique.
name.human_parameter_description: Enter part or all of the campaign name to find matching campaigns.
name.title: Name

start_date_from.description: Lower bound for StartDate (inclusive). Use YYYY-MM-DD.
start_date_from.human_parameter_description: Show campaigns that start on or after this date. Use the format YYYY-MM-DD.
start_date_from.title: Start Date From

start_date_to.description: Upper bound for StartDate (inclusive). Use YYYY-MM-DD.
start_date_to.human_parameter_description: Show campaigns that start on or before this date. Use the format YYYY-MM-DD.
start_date_to.title: Start Date To

status.human_parameter_description: Select the campaign status you want to see, like Planned, In Progress, Completed, or Aborted.
status.title: Status

type.human_parameter_description: Choose the type of campaign to filter by, such as Email, Webinar, or Trade Show.
type.title: Type

name: search_campaigns

IsDeleted.title: Is Deleted

HierarchyBudgetedCost.description: The total budgeted cost for the campaign and all child campaigns in the hierarchy.
